jobs.name: grass
jobs.prompt: Seamless tileable pixel art texture of meadow grass seen from above: many small vertical blades of different shades with a yellow undertone, seen from above (top-down), for a 16x16-tile top-down sandbox game, in the style of the attached image: natural, warm, muted palette (olive greens, earthy browns, ochre accents), calm and grounded, not toy-like. Square image. The whole image must look like a 64x64 pixel texture enlarged 16 times: every texture pixel is a crisp square block of one flat color, all blocks the same size, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients inside blocks. 6-8 colors with rich half-tones, light natural texture (fine grain, fibres, joints), soft daylight from the top-left. Even pattern with no large spot that would stand out when repeated. Tileable on all four edges. No objects, no text, no border, no outline.
